content: No, that statement is not from Friedrich Dürrenmatt's novel *Der Kommissar*. Friedrich Dürrenmatt's famous quote — **"Die Welt ist ein Irrenhaus, und wir sind alle Patienten darin"** — ("The world is an insane asylum, and we are all patients in it") appears in his play *Die Physiker* (The Physicists), not *Der Kommissar*. There is no credible evidence that this quote was used in *Der Kommissar*.
